conclusions: 1440 successful backup cron runs in 24h are scheduler invocation outcomes, NOT 1440 complete recoverable backup snapshots.
Zero public.backup_metadata entries means no authenticated, complete, certified backup artifacts recorded in the application catalog.
The disabled daily backup cron must not be enabled without knowing user intent, external backup worker readiness, encryption/replica and storage costs.
The restore-test worker has a stale heartbeat, no restore jobs and a pre-existing non-empty restore-test project; do not repurpose/delete it.
Reported RPO/RTO values are configuration targets, not measured recovery objectives. No go-live backup/restore certification.
